description: Publishes submitted human benchmark labels and recomputed rule/source-pair assessments as immutable local releases.

labels_path.description: Optional JSON Lines file; null uses the audited local working copy.

minimum_input: At least one independently completed label; empty or fabricated label releases are prohibited.
quality_gate: Recompute automatic-rule precision and source-pair diagnostics; statistical success never sets export_authorized=true.
retention_profile: Retain immutable local label snapshots and assessments; corrections publish a later release.
cancellation: No pointer changes until the complete immutable snapshot verifies.
